description: A coin key for the coins your wallet created, as the coin page's Developers dialog makes one: { key, id, webhookSecret, view }. The key (ck_live_…) and the webhook secret are shown this once: keep them. It works for set_coin_mode and award_prize and the coin API (souvenir.finance/api/v2/openapi.json), on every coin the wallet created. At most 5 live keys a wallet; revoke one with revoke_coin_key (or DELETE /api/v2/me/coinkeys/{id}, or on the coin's page). Only a coin's creator makes keys. Takes the token from sign_in, as token or as the request's Authorization: Bearer header. Refused with "Coin keys are not open yet." while the coin API's keys are not open.

name.description: A name for the key, 1 to 60 characters.

token.description: The token sign_in gave. Not needed when the request sends it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

webhookUrl.description: Optional: an https address on a public host that gets a signed POST for each step of your coins' rounds.

name: create_coin_key
title: Make a coin key
